title: VTC Vetting — Hidden — Withdraw — payload
description: Turn hidden-vetter admission off for one criterion. The criterion's named vetting is unchanged. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

criterionId.description: The Accepts criterion whose hidden-vetting parameters are withdrawn.

Response.title: VTC Vetting — Hidden — Withdraw — response payload

criterionId.description: The criterion that no longer accepts a hidden proof.

withdrawn.description: True when the criterion carried hidden-vetting parameters and they were removed. False when it carried none, so there was nothing to withdraw — a success, not a refusal.

requirementsDigest.description: The criterion's requirementsDigest after the change. It moves when withdrawn is true, because the digest covers the published parameters; it is unchanged when withdrawn is false. Null only when the criterion's manifest entry carries none.
